URL: https://www.timesofisrael.com/iranian-strike-kills-2-us-troops-in-jordan-as-tehran-vows-unforgettable-lessons/
(WebFetch — Times of Israel, newsroom, 19 July 2026)

US casualties in Jordan attack (18-19 July): 2 service members killed, 1 missing in action,
4 wounded. Names withheld pending next-of-kin notification. Iranian strike targeted forces
at Muwaffaq Salti Air Base in Jordan.

War toll (as of this article): 16 total US service members killed since the war began; over
430 wounded. [A third US service member was subsequently killed in Iraq on Saturday,
bringing the total to 17 — see CNN/CNBC 20 July.]

Iran's Supreme Leader statement: "the noble nation of Iran and the axis of resistance have
unforgettable lessons in store for it."

Deputy Foreign Minister Kazem Gharibabadi: "We have also suspended our commitments; we are
not implementing them."

US Defense Secretary Pete Hegseth (posted online): "Godspeed, heroes. Their sacrifice only
stiffens our resolve."

CENTCOM confirmed a seventh consecutive night of strikes targeting Iranian surveillance
sites, military logistics, weapons storage and maritime capabilities.

Context: conflict began late February 2026; interim MoU signed the previous month collapsed,
leading to escalating tit-for-tat attacks.
